entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Major prophet of Judah (c. 740–681 BCE) during the reigns of Uzziah through Hezekiah. His oracles include visions of the Messianic age (Isaiah 9, 11), the Suffering Servant (Isaiah 53), and the coming of a new heavens and new earth. The most quoted OT prophet in the New Testament.
